choices: Use Standard gate because auth/schema are active; Compact is ineligible.
Run one bounded P1 scheduler tick: claim scope/inbox/events/ownership, do first-tick legacy-name migration, dispatch all READY lanes, return without waiting.
Do not block P1 on auth/schema; keep P2 and P3 ACTIVE and lease the independent docs lane to idle compatible P4.
Before each visible/prompted lane, use assign_agent_name.py reserve/rename/verify, then prompt only the verified name without --wait.
Use render_agent_status.py-style status so the Herdr list exposes slot, role, task, and live state.

P2/P3 are busy on existing active lanes, so reusing them would multiplex unrelated work through occupied agents; P4 is the compatible idle P2-P4 worker capacity.
Dynamic names are display handles, not stable identity; stable routing remains slot/session/lane/generation/scope in control-state.
Legacy hdr_pN names may be migrated on first tick without resetting working sessions, preserving current auth/schema work.
Docs is independent, so it is READY and can be fanned out while auth and schema continue.
